dataset: South-pole permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) larger than 5 km2

source.derived_from: LOLA permanent-shadow masks (Mazarico et al. 2011, Icarus 211, 1066-1081)

notes: Rings are closed by implicit wrap; the closing vertex is not repeated.
Multi-part polygons are stored as independent rings; holes are not used by this product.
Boundaries trace the LOLA permanent-shadow mask; the 5 km2 area threshold excludes smaller PSRs.
near_crater names the IAU crater whose centre is closest (within crater radius + 6 km); it is a label, not a claim that the PSR lies inside that crater.
